description: This file defines an Android Fragment class called AppRestrictionEnforcerFragment, which provides a user interface for setting app restrictions through Android's RestrictionsManager and DevicePolicyManager. It manages various types of restrictions such as boolean, string, integer, choice, multiselect, and bundle array restrictions. The class handles UI interactions, loading current restrictions, saving updated restrictions, and manipulating the restriction data structures.
